disableHint: Confirm your password and an authenticator or recovery code. Recovery codes will be invalidated and other sessions signed out. Your next sign-in will use only your password.
disabledSuccess: Two-factor authentication disabled. You can enable it again whenever you want.
disabledStatus: Disabled by default. Enable it whenever you want to protect your account.
title: Confirm it is you
subtitle: Protect your data and your company operations.
serverKeyMissing: The server has not received the security encryption key yet. Contact support.
emailText: We will send an 8-digit code to {email}.
codeSent: Code sent. Also check your spam folder.
mfaSetupText: Confirm your password to generate a key in Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a compatible app.
keyText: Scan the QR Code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator or a compatible app. If you prefer, enter the key manually.
codeText: Enter the current authenticator code or a recovery code.
enabledText: Keep these codes in a safe place. Each code works once and will not be shown again.
trustDeviceHint: Use it only on a personal computer or phone. You will not need to enter the code on every login.
recoveryFileHint: Each code works once. Keep this file in a safe place.
error: We could not complete the action.

mfa.title: Security recommendation
mfa.copy: Two-step authentication is optional, but it helps prevent unauthorised access.
mfa.modalCopy: Two-step authentication is optional, but it helps prevent unauthorised access even if your password is discovered.
